in_arabic.name: مُضَطَهِر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم الذي يُنزل على النبي محمد، يُرمز إلى التطهير والطهارة
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُعْطٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ يُذَكّى بِالرُّوحِ الْأَمِينِ، يَومَ بَعَثَهُ بِالْحِقْوِ أَوَّلَ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ، وَبِهِ تُنَزَّلَ مِنَ السَمَاءِ النُّورُ، يُصَلّى عَلَيْهِ صَلَواتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَامُ، وَيُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَسَائِرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَيُقَرَّبُ إِلَيهِ بِالذُرُوعِ وَالصَفَائِحِ وَالزُّهرَاتِ، وَيُفَضَّلُ عَلَى الْبَشَرِ بِالنُّورِ وَالسُعُودِ، يَخُفُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ السَّيُولَ وَيُقَلِّلُ عَلَيْهِ الرِزْقَ، وَيُتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، وَيُعْطِيهِ اللَّهُ بِالرِزْقِ وَالسُعُودِ وَالنُّورِ مِنَ الْأُولیاءِ وَالصَفَواتِ

in_urdu.name: مضطہر
in_urdu.meaning: پروفیٹ محمد (صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہ وسلم) پر نازل ہونے والا نام، جو تھوڑا ہوتا ہے اور پاک ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: وہ بندہ جو اللہ تعالیٰ نے اپنی روح کے ذریعے پاک کرنے والا بنایا، اس نے آپ کو ہدایت کے ساتھ بھیجا، آپ پہلے انبیا میں ہیں، اور آپ کی پھول کی طرح روشنی ہے، آپ پر اللہ تعالیٰ کی برکت ہے اور تمام مومنین کی برکت ہے، آپ کی طرف ذہر، صفائح، زہرے کے ذریعے قربت حاصل کرتے ہیں، آپ پر اللہ تعالیٰ نے نور اور فلاح کا فضل کیا ہے اور آپ کو اللہ تعالیٰ نے بھاری مصائب سے نجات دی اور آپ کو رہنما بنایا، آپ پر اللہ تعالیٰ روزی اور سعادت کا بہا کرتا ہے

data.cultural_impact: The name Muddaththir carries great significance in Islamic culture, as it is mentioned in the Quran itself. This name is mentioned in Surah Al-Inshirah (84:6), which is a passage from the last Surah in the Quran. This late placement in the Quran symbolizes the extreme importance placed on this concept of protection and preservation. The use of this name in the Quran demonstrates the Islamic belief that Allah (God) protects and shields His believers, and that they should do the same for one another. In Islamic cultures, this name is often given as a reminder of the fact that believers must always strive to protect and preserve the sanctity of their communities, families, and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Muddaththir lies in its reminder of the protective nature of Allah. The name represents Allah's role as a defender and protector, and it serves as a reminder to Muslims of their need to seek Allah's protection and guidance in their lives. The name also underscores the concept of protective brotherhood and sisterhood among Muslims, as it encourages believers to look out for one another and protect each other from harm. Ultimately, the name Muddaththir reflects the essential Islamic values of faith, community, and protection, and it serves as a constant reminder of Allah's love and guidance for his believers.

historical_references.reference: Muddaththir mentioned in Hadiths as a name of a righteous man who was granted the promise of intercession on the Day of Judgement by Prophet Muhammad (PBUH).
historical_references.context: Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said that Muddaththir, along with other righteous people, will be granted the intercession on the Day of Judgement. This hadith is mentioned in various collections of Hadiths, including Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.

historical_references.reference: Muddaththir is also mentioned in a story in the Sirah of Imam Ibn Hisham, which relates an incident when the Prophet (PBUH) was attacked by unbelievers during the Battle of Uhud.
historical_references.context: During the Battle of Uhud, the Prophet (PBUH) and his Companions were attacked by the unbelievers from the rear, causing chaos and confusion. In the midst of this, a man named Muddaththir, who was not a Muslim, came to the Prophet's aid and fought bravely alongside the Muslims. The Prophet (PBUH) later praised Muddaththir for his bravery and offered him conversion to Islam. However, Muddaththir declined and returned to his people. This incident is recorded in the Sirah of Ibn Hisham.
